name: Supper at Sixteenth
tagline: A private dining room in the Mission for 12 to 30, with a 20-minute pasta tasting before everyone sits down.
bio: I'm Sofia. I cook in a back room off 16th Street that seats 30 at one long table. Companies book it for customer dinners: I run a short hands-on pasta tasting while people arrive, then get out of the way so they can talk. Room, food, service, tax and cleanup are one price.
terms: Free to cancel up to 14 days before. Inside 14 days, 50% of the quote. Guest count can change until 72 hours before.
backupPlan: My sous-chef Teo runs the kitchen with the same menu if I'm out; you meet him on the planning call.

experiences.name: Customer dinner in a private room
experiences.desc: A 20-minute pasta tasting at the pass while guests arrive, then a three-course family-style dinner at one long table. The room is yours for 3 hours.
experiences.allIn: Room, food, wine or zero-proof drinks, service, tax and tip. No minimum spend above 12 guests.
experiences.av: Screen and a mic for a 5-minute welcome; strong Wi-Fi
experiences.dietary: Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free mains on every menu; tell me about allergies a week ahead.
menu: Tasting: hand-cut tagliatelle, brown butter and sage
Rigatoni all'amatriciana or wild mushroom ragù
runOfShow: 6:30 Guests arrive, pasta tasting at the pass (20 min)
experiences.branding: Printed menus and place cards with your name. Needs 1 week.

experiences.name: Exec roundtable breakfast
experiences.desc: A quiet room for 8 to 16 leaders, a proper breakfast, and service that stays out of the conversation.
experiences.allIn: Room, breakfast, coffee, service and tax.
experiences.av: Quiet room, no screen needed; a small screen on request
